4. The Board of Directors have at its meeting held on May 14 2025 recommended a dividend of Rs. 12 per equity share of the face value of Rs. 2 each aggregating Rs. 5478.8 million. The recommended dividend is subject to the approval of the shareholders at the ensuing Annual General Meeting

5. During the quarter ended March 31 2025 330503 year to date 886137 equity shares of Rs. 2 each fully paid up were allotted upon exercise of the vested stock options pursuant to the Lupin Employees Stock Option Plans ESOPs resulting in an increase in the paid up share capital by Rs. 0.7 million year to date Rs. 1.8 million and securities premium account by Rs. 334.0 million year to date Rs. 1082.3 million.

6. During the quarter ended December 31 2024 and year ended March 31 2025 the Group has made a provision of Rs. 856.1 million USD 10 million and Rs. 1441.2 million USD 17 million respectively towards ongoing disputes.

7. During the year ended March 31 2025 Lupin Limited and its subsidiary agreed to settle the dispute for an amount of USD 9.0 million Rs. 750.5 million in connection with the drug Glumetza® without admitting any liability for any wrongdoing with a view to avoid the costs and uncertainties of continued litigation.

8. During the year ended March 31 2024 Sales Income from operations includes milestone income of Rs. 2052.5 million USD 25.0 million from AbbVie for successful achievement of key milestone for its Phase 1 clinical stage MALT1 inhibitor program.

9. During the quarter and year ended March 31 2025 the Group has recognised an impairment charge of Rs. 1135.3 milion and Rs. 1209.0 milion respectively related certain tangible intangible assets and goodwill. During the quarter and year ended March 31 2024 the Group had recognised an impairment charge of Rs. 2012.5 milion related to intangibles assets including discontinued ANDAs and certain tangible assets.

12. The figures for the quarter ended March 31 2025 and March 31 2024 are the balancing figures between audited figures in respect of the full financial year and the unaudited published year to date figures up to the third quarter ended December 31 2024 and December 31 2023 respectively.
